programme.title: #IkLome / #LIKEME
programme.desc: Caro retires again at Titin. It is a happy reunion. Yemi is also happy that his BFF is back. Caro realized that her future is in Antwerp. programme.title: Break / Kapot Gaan
programme.desc: In the first episode, Gloria will break the adrenaline with Aaron Blommaert and Francisco Schuster. They start as a counselor in an accident with injured, then they put a fire their own hand and as icing on the cake they undergo the official adrenaline test from the police training. / In de eerste aflevering gaat Gloria kapot van de adrenaline met Aaron Blommaert en Francisco Schuster. Ze starten als hulpverlener bij een ongeval met gewonden, daarna blussen ze eigenhandig een brand en als kers op de taart ondergaan ze de officiële adrenalinetest uit de politieopleiding.

programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: During an election debate, Tess asks what Soekie will do about the troll that lives at school. Everyone laughs Tess. Soekie is sorry for her girlfriend and lies that there is indeed a troll living at school. Pedro wants hard proof from Soekie. If she cannot deliver that, it means that she is lying and demands her resignation. / Tijdens een verkiezingsdebat vraagt Tess wat Soekie gaat doen aan de trol die op school leeft. Iedereen lacht Tess uit. Soekie vindt het erg voor haar vriendin en liegt dat er wel degelijk een trol op school woont. Pedro wil hard bewijs van Soekie. Indien ze dat niet kan leveren, wil dat zeggen dat ze liegt en eist hij haar ontslag.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Geert loves Christmas. He thinks it's a shame that Christmas is only celebrated one day a year. The hoppers decide to celebrate Christmas every day to do Geert a favor. Arno believes that they should also celebrate his birthday every day, because that is his favorite day. In that case, Jackie also wants to celebrate Halloween every day and for Daria, Russian Literature Day is her favorite holiday. The hoppers try to celebrate all parties every day, but that immediately results in chaos. / Geert houdt van kerst. Hij vindt het jammer dat kerst maar een dag per jaar gevierd wordt. De Hoppers beslissen om vanaf nu elke dag kerst te vieren om Geert een plezier te doen. Arno vindt dat ze dan ook elke dag zijn verjaardag moeten vieren, want dat is zijn lievelingsdag. Jackie wil in dat geval ook elke dag Halloween vieren en voor Daria is Russische literatuurdag haar favoriete feestdag. De Hoppers proberen elke dag alle feesten te vieren, maar dat mondt meteen uit in chaos.

programme.title: Our house, new house / Ons huis, nieuw huis
programme.desc: Tom and Nancy live with their youngest daughter Polien in a charming workers' home in Berchem. But the house is very illogical. For example, Polien always has to go through the parental bedroom to be able to go to her attic room. Nancy has pledged her heart to the neighborhood and she is even called the mayor of the street. But Tom, who likes to tinker with cycling, dreams out loudly of a garage for his two -wheelers. Ken and Kristien will have to clear the air. / Tom en Nancy wonen met hun jongste dochter Polien in een charmante arbeiderswoning in Berchem. Maar het huis steekt heel onlogisch in elkaar. Zo moet Polien steeds door de ouderlijke slaapkamer om zelf naar haar zolderkamer te kunnen. Nancy heeft haar hart verpand aan de buurt en ze wordt zelfs de burgemeester van de straat genoemd. programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: In the background of social rebellions and class struggles in Italy just before World War I, two passionate love stories and one great story of the victim are intertwined. Carrara, 1913, the young Brando works in the marble mine in Colonnati, owned by engineer Corradi. Brando is an idealist who struggles to improve the dug working conditions. A serious accident that happens to a miner takes him to the Holy Crown Hospital led by the honorable mother Agnese. At that point, the suffering meets Silvia, who volunteers as a nurse. The brand immediately touches the deep humanity of a young woman, and later returned to the hospital to meet her again. Among the attraction, they feel they share the same ideals. Leopoldo Corradi, the most influential person in the city, suggested to his son Corrad to run for MP Carrara, making her first son Albert. Young housekeeper Maddalena, a sister's brand, is under sharp and constant criticism of Mrs. Maffei, who rejects her permit for Maddalena's free evening so that she can celebrate her birthday with the family. The brand overwhelms the anger for this new act of abuse, goes to the Corradi villa, and reveals that Silvia is, in fact, the wife of his boss Corrad Corradi. / U pozadini društvenih pobuna i klasnih borbi u Italiji malo prije Prvog svjetskog rata prepleću se dvije strastvene ljubavne priče i jedna velika priča o žrtvi.Carrara, 1913., mladi Brando radi u rudniku mramora u Colonnati, čiji je vlasnik inženjer Corradi. Brando je idealista koji se bori da poboljša uvjete rada kopača. Teška nesreća koja se dogodi jednom rudaru odvede ga u bolnicu Sveta Kruna koju vodi časna majka Agnese. Na tom mjestu patnji upoznaje Silviju, koja volontira kao medicinska sestra. Branda smjesta dirne duboka ljudskost mlade žene, te se on naknadno vrati u bolnicu kako bi je ponovno susreo. Među, pored privlačnosti, oni osjete da dijele iste ideale. Leopoldo Corradi, najutjecajnija osoba u gradu, predloži svom sinu Corradu da se kandidira za zastupnika okruga Carrara, čime naljuti svog prvog sina Alberta. Mlada kućna pomoćnica Maddalena, Brandova sestra,pod oštrim je i stalnim kritikama gđice Maffei, koja joj odbije dozvolu za Maddalenino slobodno veče, kako bi mogla proslaviti svoj rođendan sa porodicom. Branda obuzima gnjev zbog tog novog čina zlostavljanja, odlazi u vilu Corradijevih, a tamo otkrije da je Silvia, zapravo, žena njegovog gazde Corrada Corradija.

programme.title: Got Carnot / Saadi Carnot
programme.desc: Documentary film on Lazarea Carnot, Mathematician, Military Leader, President of the National Assembly of France and one of the leaders of the French Revolution, which lived during the rule of Louis XVI. He was extremely interested in poetry and moral advice Saadi Shirazi, Iranian poet, and drafted inspiration for the leading of the French Revolution. Because of that attachment, Lazari Carnot gives his son's name Saadi and orders that the next generations of his family give Saadi's name to his children. Through interviews with French intellectuals and family of Carnot, in addition to presenting Lazar Carnot's personality and his role in the French Revolution, in the documentary on the influence of Saadi's moral teachings and his family, learning that emphasized the importance of ethics in politics. / Dokumentarni film o Lazareu Carnotu, matematičaru, vojnom vođi, predsjedniku Nacionalne skupštine Francuske i jednom od lidera Francuske revolucije, koji je živio u vrijeme vladavine Luja XVI. Bio je izuzetno zainteresiran za poeziju i moralne savjete Saadija Širazija, iranskog pjesnika, te je iz njih crpio inspiraciju za vođenje Francuske revolucije. Zbog te privrženosti, Lazare Carnot svom sinu daje ime Saadi i nalaže da i naredne generacije njegove porodice daju ime Saadi svojoj djeci. Kroz intervjue sa francuskim intelektualcima i porodicom Carnot, pored predstavljanja ličnosti Lazare Carnota i njegove uloge u Francuskoj revoluciji, u dokumentarcu o utjecaju Saadijevih moralnih učenja na njega i njegovu porodicu, učenja koja su istaknula važnost etike u politici.

The effect develops amid the great vineyards of the picturesque province of Tuscany. / Това е една история за убийство, заговор, кръв и тайни, но преди всичко за любов - една невъзможна любов между двама млади, Аурора Тавиани и Алесандро Монфорте.Аурора Тавиани, несправедливо обвинена в убийството на Лука Монфорте, е освободена от затвора след 8-годишна присъда и се прибира в къщата на баба си.... В центъра на събития са бившият приятел на Аурора и неговите братя, майка й, истинската убийца на Лука и отношенията между враждебните фамилии - Тавиани и Монфорте.Действието се развива на фона на великите лозя на живописната провинция Тоскана.

Tennis: Davis Cup: Match 5: Australia - Belgium / Тенис: Купа Дейвис: Мач 5: Австралия - Белгия
programme.desc: The tournament was established in 1900 at the initiative of American tennis player Dwight Davis, with the first edition being a meeting between the US and the UK. Gradually, the race is growing and today is among the largest sporting events with the participation of many countries around the world. Each clash is held in format up to three wins from five matches - on the first day two singles are played, and in the second one follows a match in pairs and two reverse singles. Since 2019, the structure of the tournament has been upgraded and already includes qualification stages, group phase and final eight, in which the top eight teams argue for the award. / Турнирът е създаден през 1900 г. по инициатива на американския тенисист Дуайт Дейвис, като първото издание е било среща между САЩ и Великобритания. Постепенно надпреварата се разраства и днес е сред най-мащабните спортни събития с участие на множество държави от целия свят. Всеки сблъсък се провежда във формат до три победи от пет срещи – в първия ден се изиграват два сингъла, а във втория следват мач по двойки и два обратни сингъла. От 2019 г. структурата на турнира е модернизирана, като вече включва квалификационни етапи, групова фаза и финална осмица, в която най-добрите осем отбора спорят за отличието.

programme.title: Football: Elite Champions League of Asia: Round 1: Melbourne City - Sanfrech Hiroshima / Футбол: Елитна Шампионска лига на Азия: 1 кръг: Мелбърн Сити - Санфрече Хирошима
programme.desc: The Elite Champions League of Asia is a football club competition, featuring the best clubs from Asian football leagues, organized under the auspices of AFC. This is the most important club football competition on the continent and is the equivalent of the European Champions League. By the fall of 2024, the tournament was taken as the AFC Champions League of Asia, but from that moment the race was renamed to the elite Champions League of Asia / Елитната Шампионска лига на Азия е футболно клубно състезание, в което участват най-добрите клубове от азиатските футболни лиги, организирано под егидата на АФК . Това е най-важното клубно футболно състезание на континента и е еквивалент на Европейската шампионска лига. До есента на 2024 г. турнирът е извстен като АФК Шампионска лига на Азия, но от този момент надпреварата е преименувана на Елитна Шампионска лига на Азия

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E25, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E25, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Path to space / Put u svemir
programme.desc: The Right Stuff - (E02, Pov. Series, 2020) based on literary successes Toma Wolfea, series The Right Stuff is an inspiring story about the beginnings of the American space program and legendary first American astronauts, mercury from Mercury. The series objectively displays the first American reality show, when ambitious astronauts and their families have become famous people who competing for money, fame and immortality. In 1959, at the peak of the cold war, America is afraid to lag behind as a nation because the Soviet Union dominates in the space race. But the US government has a solution - send a man to space. That huge task of the Western NASA, the Group of the best engineers in the country estimates that they will need decades to achieve that feat, but only two years. NASA engineers, including the Bob Gilruth Rocket Scientist and the Passionate Chris Kraft (Eric Ladin), race over time under the growing pressure from Washington. Together they choose the seven of the astronaut among military experimental pilots. These are ordinary people, until completely unknown to the public, and a few days after they presented them to the world, they turn them into heroes before they did any heroic work. At the heart of everything there are Major John Glenn (Patrick J. Adams), a legendary pilot Marine and a committed family man, and Capri Corvette Alan Shepard, one of the best pilots in the history of the American Navy. The rest of the seven-seater from Mercury are: Captain Gordo Cooper, the youngest of seven, whose choice surprised everything; Wally Schirra (Aaron Staton), a pilot who likes to compete and perform pies; Scott Carpenter (James Lafferty), which other astronauts gave a nickname poet; Deke Slayton, (Micah Stock), silent but incredibly intelligent pilot and engineer; And Gus Grissom, (Michael Trotter), a decorated military veteran who will become another man in the universe. The series also monitors the family of astronauts, ... / The Right Stuff - (E02, pov. serija, SAD, 2020) Zasnovana na književnoj uspješnici Toma Wolfea, serija The Right Stuff nadahnjujuća je priča o počecima američkog svemirskog programa i legendarnim prvim američkim astronautima, Sedmorci iz Mercuryja. Serija objektivno prikazuje prvi američki reality show, kada su ambiciozni astronauti i njihove obitelji u tren oka postali slavne osobe koje se natječu za novac, slavu i besmrtnost. Godine 1959., na vrhuncu hladnoga rata, Amerika se boji da zaostaje kao nacija jer Sovjetski Savez dominira u svemirskoj utrci. Ali američka vlada ima rješenje - poslati čovjeka u svemir. Taj golem zadatak zapada novoutemeljenu NASA-u, skupina najboljih inženjera u zemlji procjenjuje da će im trebati desetljeća da ostvare taj podvig, ali imaju samo dvije godine. NASA-ini inženjeri, među kojima su raketni znanstvenik Bob Gilruth (Patrick Fischler) i strastveni Chris Kraft (Eric Ladin), utrkuju se s vremenom pod sve većim pritiskom iz Washingtona. Zajedno biraju sedmoricu astronauta među vojnim pokusnim pilotima. To su obični ljudi, dotad potpuno nepoznati javnosti, a nekoliko dana nakon što su ih predstavili svijetu, pretvaraju ih u junake prije nego što su učinili ikakvo junačko djelo. U središtu svega nalaze se bojnik John Glenn (Patrick J. Adams), legendarni pokusni pilot marinaca i predan obiteljski čovjek, i kapetan korvete Alan Shepard (Jake McDorman), jedan od najboljih pokusnih pilota u povijesti Američke ratne mornarice. Ostali su članovi Sedmorke iz Mercuryja: satnik Gordo Cooper (Colin ODonoghue), najmlađi od sedmorice čiji je odabir iznenadio sve; Wally Schirra (Aaron Staton), pilot koji se voli nadmetati i izvoditi psine; Scott Carpenter (James Lafferty), kojemu su ostali astronauti dali nadimak Pjesnik; Deke Slayton, (Micah Stock), šutljiv, ali nevjerojatno inteligentan pilot i inženjer; i Gus Grissom, (Michael Trotter), odlikovani vojni veteran koji će postati drugi čovjek u svemiru. Serija također prati obitelji astronauta,...

programme.title: Dr. Beck / Dr. Beck
programme.desc: Dr. Beck - (Show Magazine, Croatia) You decided to eat healthy? By entering healthy, organic foods, you want to improve your health, lose weight, feel better. And that's certainly a good decision. But what about when a healthy diet becomes an obsession, when it takes control of your life and all day is about to eat what to eat and where to find "healthy" foods? Then you most likely have orthorexia. We talk about this diet disorder on Dr. Beck. All about the symptoms, causes and treatment of this disorder will be learned from the psychiatrist of Hrvoje Handl and nutritionist Maja Žanko. Mateja Klemencic Klicper will be shared with orthorexia ... / Dr. Beck - (show magazin, Hrvatska) Odlučili ste hraniti se zdravo? No što kad zdrava prehrana postane opsesija, kad preuzme kontrolu nad vašim životom i cijeli dan vam se vrti oko toga što jesti i gdje naći "zdrave" namirnice? Onda najvjerojatnije imate ortoreksiju. O ovom poremećaju prehrane govorimo u emisiji Dr. Beck. Sve o simptomima, uzrocima i liječenju ovog poremećaja saznat ćemo od psihijatra Hrvoja Handla i nutricionistice Maje Žanko. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E26, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promeda owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E26, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Path to space / Put u svemir
programme.desc: The Right Stuff - (e03, pov. Series, 2020) based on the literary success of Tom Wolfea, the Series The Right Stuff is an inspiring story about the beginnings of the American space program and legendary first American astronauts, mercury from Mercury. The series objectively displays the first American reality show, when ambitious astronauts and their families have become famous people who competing for money, fame and immortality. In 1959, at the peak of the cold war, America is afraid to lag behind as a nation because the Soviet Union dominates in the space race. But the US government has a solution - send a man to space. That huge task of the Western NASA, the Group of the best engineers in the country estimates that they will need decades to achieve that feat, but only two years. NASA engineers, including the Bob Gilruth Rocket Scientist and the Passionate Chris Kraft (Eric Ladin), race over time under the growing pressure from Washington. Together they choose the seven of the astronaut among military experimental pilots. These are ordinary people, until completely unknown to the public, and a few days after they presented them to the world, they turn them into heroes before they did any heroic work. At the heart of everything there are Major John Glenn (Patrick J. Adams), a legendary pilot Marine and a committed family man, and Capri Corvette Alan Shepard, one of the best pilots in the history of the American Navy. The rest of the seven-seater from Mercury are: Captain Gordo Cooper, the youngest of seven, whose choice surprised everything; Wally Schirra (Aaron Staton), a pilot who likes to compete and perform pies; Scott Carpenter (James Lafferty), which other astronauts gave a nickname poet; Deke Slayton, (Micah Stock), silent but incredibly intelligent pilot and engineer; And Gus Grissom, (Michael Trotter), a decorated military veteran who will become another man in the universe. The series also monitors the family of astronauts, ... / The Right Stuff - (E03, pov. serija, SAD, 2020) Zasnovana na književnoj uspješnici Toma Wolfea, serija The Right Stuff nadahnjujuća je priča o počecima američkog svemirskog programa i legendarnim prvim američkim astronautima, Sedmorci iz Mercuryja. Serija objektivno prikazuje prvi američki reality show, kada su ambiciozni astronauti i njihove obitelji u tren oka postali slavne osobe koje se natječu za novac, slavu i besmrtnost. Godine 1959., na vrhuncu hladnoga rata, Amerika se boji da zaostaje kao nacija jer Sovjetski Savez dominira u svemirskoj utrci. Ali američka vlada ima rješenje - poslati čovjeka u svemir. Taj golem zadatak zapada novoutemeljenu NASA-u, skupina najboljih inženjera u zemlji procjenjuje da će im trebati desetljeća da ostvare taj podvig, ali imaju samo dvije godine. NASA-ini inženjeri, među kojima su raketni znanstvenik Bob Gilruth (Patrick Fischler) i strastveni Chris Kraft (Eric Ladin), utrkuju se s vremenom pod sve većim pritiskom iz Washingtona. Zajedno biraju sedmoricu astronauta među vojnim pokusnim pilotima. To su obični ljudi, dotad potpuno nepoznati javnosti, a nekoliko dana nakon što su ih predstavili svijetu, pretvaraju ih u junake prije nego što su učinili ikakvo junačko djelo. U središtu svega nalaze se bojnik John Glenn (Patrick J. Adams), legendarni pokusni pilot marinaca i predan obiteljski čovjek, i kapetan korvete Alan Shepard (Jake McDorman), jedan od najboljih pokusnih pilota u povijesti Američke ratne mornarice. Ostali su članovi Sedmorke iz Mercuryja: satnik Gordo Cooper (Colin ODonoghue), najmlađi od sedmorice čiji je odabir iznenadio sve; Wally Schirra (Aaron Staton), pilot koji se voli nadmetati i izvoditi psine; Scott Carpenter (James Lafferty), kojemu su ostali astronauti dali nadimak Pjesnik; Deke Slayton, (Micah Stock), šutljiv, ali nevjerojatno inteligentan pilot i inženjer; i Gus Grissom, (Michael Trotter), odlikovani vojni veteran koji će postati drugi čovjek u svemiru. Serija također prati obitelji astronauta,...

Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. programme.desc: The Right Stuff - (e03, pov. Series, 2020) based on the literary success of Tom Wolfea, the Series The Right Stuff is an inspiring story about the beginnings of the American space program and legendary first American astronauts, mercury from Mercury. programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E27, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E27, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Eva Fischer / Eva Fischer
programme.desc: Eva Fischer - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2023) adored her Hollywood stars, friends with Morricon, Chagall, Dali and Picasso, and although she was born in Croatia, she remained unknown to our public. Eva Fischer is the daughter of the last Daruvar rabbi, who gained worldwide fame in Rome. The father's service took the family to Serbia, and World War II destroyed forever. The father was killed by the Nazis, and Eva, his mother and little brother will survive, among other things, thanks to Eva's painting skill. Eva Fischer has never exhibited in Croatia for her life, and at the initiative of the City of Daruvar she symbolically returned home with an exhibition of lithographs and engravings in the gallery that today bears her name. The story of a unique author, a woman who, in the middle of the last century in the male world, was equal and respected, about the victim who spoke about the suffering in the Holocaust only decades later, the story of the artist, mother, sister, friend and teacher tells her closest, but also the people whose lives have enriched and in a special way. Music Authors: Ivana Đula and Luka Vrbanić R .: Marijana Kranjec ... / Eva Fischer - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Obožavale su je holivudske zvijezde, prijateljevala je s Morriconeom, Chagallom, Dalijem i Picassom, a iako je rođena u Hrvatskoj, našoj je javnosti ostala nepoznata. Eva Fischer kći je posljednjeg daruvarskog rabina, koja je svjetsku slavu stekla u Rimu. Očeva služba obitelj je odvela u Srbiju, a Drugi svjetski rat zauvijek je razorio. Oca su ubili nacisti, a Eva, majka i maleni brat preživjet će među ostalim i zahvaljujući Evinu slikarskom umijeću. Eva Fischer za života nikada nije izlagala u Hrvatskoj, a na inicijativu grada Daruvara simbolično se vratila kući izložbom litografija i gravura u galeriji koja danas nosi njezino ime. Priču o jedinstvenoj autorici, ženi koja je već sredinom prošlog stoljeća u muškom svijetu bila ravnopravna i uvažavana, o žrtvi koja je o stradanju u holokaustu progovorila tek desetljećima poslije, priču o umjetnici, majci, sestri, prijateljici i učiteljici pričaju njezini najbliži, ali i ljudi čije je živote obogatila i na poseban način usmjerila. Autori glazbe: Ivana Đula i Luka Vrbanić R.: Marijana Kranjec...

programme.title: Earth / Zemlja
programme.desc: Earth - (E01, Educational Program, England, 2023) Discover the unimaginable four billion years old story about our native planet, told in five dramatic episodes. This instructive biography of the country explores the epic moments of our planet. From the first rainy drops that turned him into the water world until the arrival of his most amazing inhabitants - us. But people are in the second plan of this narrative. The central position is occupied by Earth. We follow what was happening in our world before we cracked from the mud - and this includes bombing from space, extreme changes in climate and collision of entire continents. ---------- Chris Packham explores one of the darkest periods in the history of the country: the largest mass extinction that the planet experienced, when as many as 90% of all kinds were extinct 252 million years ago. This extraordinary moment in the history of the earth brought life to the edge, causing a desolation and destruction of unprecedented proportions. But life somehow managed to recover, and the new geological era announced the dinosaur era. R .: Tom Hewitson ... / Earth - (E01, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2023) Otkrijte nezamislivu četiri milijarde godina staru priču o našem zavičajnom planetu, ispričanu u pet dramatičnih epizoda. Ova poučna biografija Zemlje istražuje epske trenutke našeg planeta. Od prvih kišnih kapi koje su ga pretvorile u vodeni svijet do dolaska njegovih najnevjerojatnijih stanovnika - nas. Ali ljudi su u drugom planu ove pripovijesti. Središnji položaj zauzima Zemlja. Pratimo što se događalo na našem svijetu prije nego smo ispuzali iz blata - a to uključuje bombardiranja iz svemira, ekstremne promjene klime i sudare cijelih kontinenata. -------- Chris Packham istražuje jedno od najmračnijih razdoblja u povijesti Zemlje: najveće masovno izumiranje koje je planet doživio, kada je prije 252 milijuna godina izumrlo čak 90% svih vrsta. Taj izvanredan trenutak u povijesti Zemlje doveo je život do ruba, izazvavši pustoš i razaranje neviđenih razmjera. No život se nekako uspio oporaviti, a nova geološka era najavila je doba dinosaura. R.: Tom Hewitson...

programme.title: Path to space / Put u svemir
programme.desc: The Right Stuff - (E04, Pov. Series, 2020) based on literary successes Tom Wolfea, Series The Right Stuff is an inspiring story about the beginnings of the American space program and legendary first American astronauts, mercury seven. The series objectively displays the first American reality show, when ambitious astronauts and their families have become famous people who competing for money, fame and immortality. In 1959, at the peak of the cold war, America is afraid to lag behind as a nation because the Soviet Union dominates in the space race. But the US government has a solution - send a man to space. That huge task of the Western NASA, the Group of the best engineers in the country estimates that they will need decades to achieve that feat, but only two years. NASA engineers, including the Bob Gilruth Rocket Scientist and the Passionate Chris Kraft (Eric Ladin), race over time under the growing pressure from Washington. Together they choose the seven of the astronaut among military experimental pilots. These are ordinary people, until completely unknown to the public, and a few days after they presented them to the world, they turn them into heroes before they did any heroic work. At the heart of everything there are Major John Glenn (Patrick J. Adams), a legendary pilot Marine and a committed family man, and Capri Corvette Alan Shepard, one of the best pilots in the history of the American Navy. The rest of the seven-seater from Mercury are: Captain Gordo Cooper, the youngest of seven, whose choice surprised everything; Wally Schirra (Aaron Staton), a pilot who likes to compete and perform pies; Scott Carpenter (James Lafferty), which other astronauts gave a nickname poet; Deke Slayton, (Micah Stock), silent but incredibly intelligent pilot and engineer; And Gus Grissom, (Michael Trotter), a decorated military veteran who will become another man in the universe. The series also monitors the family of astronauts, ... / The Right Stuff - (E04, pov. serija, SAD, 2020) Zasnovana na književnoj uspješnici Toma Wolfea, serija The Right Stuff nadahnjujuća je priča o počecima američkog svemirskog programa i legendarnim prvim američkim astronautima, Sedmorci iz Mercuryja. Serija objektivno prikazuje prvi američki reality show, kada su ambiciozni astronauti i njihove obitelji u tren oka postali slavne osobe koje se natječu za novac, slavu i besmrtnost. Godine 1959., na vrhuncu hladnoga rata, Amerika se boji da zaostaje kao nacija jer Sovjetski Savez dominira u svemirskoj utrci. Ali američka vlada ima rješenje - poslati čovjeka u svemir. Taj golem zadatak zapada novoutemeljenu NASA-u, skupina najboljih inženjera u zemlji procjenjuje da će im trebati desetljeća da ostvare taj podvig, ali imaju samo dvije godine. NASA-ini inženjeri, među kojima su raketni znanstvenik Bob Gilruth (Patrick Fischler) i strastveni Chris Kraft (Eric Ladin), utrkuju se s vremenom pod sve većim pritiskom iz Washingtona. Zajedno biraju sedmoricu astronauta među vojnim pokusnim pilotima. To su obični ljudi, dotad potpuno nepoznati javnosti, a nekoliko dana nakon što su ih predstavili svijetu, pretvaraju ih u junake prije nego što su učinili ikakvo junačko djelo. U središtu svega nalaze se bojnik John Glenn (Patrick J. Adams), legendarni pokusni pilot marinaca i predan obiteljski čovjek, i kapetan korvete Alan Shepard (Jake McDorman), jedan od najboljih pokusnih pilota u povijesti Američke ratne mornarice. Ostali su članovi Sedmorke iz Mercuryja: satnik Gordo Cooper (Colin ODonoghue), najmlađi od sedmorice čiji je odabir iznenadio sve; Wally Schirra (Aaron Staton), pilot koji se voli nadmetati i izvoditi psine; Scott Carpenter (James Lafferty), kojemu su ostali astronauti dali nadimak Pjesnik; Deke Slayton, (Micah Stock), šutljiv, ali nevjerojatno inteligentan pilot i inženjer; i Gus Grissom, (Michael Trotter), odlikovani vojni veteran koji će postati drugi čovjek u svemiru. Serija također prati obitelji astronauta,...

programme.title: Secrets in the sand / Tajne u pijesku
programme.desc: Secrets in the Sand - (E06, Nature. Film, Canada, 2023) We rarely remember the desert when it comes to climate change, but with an increase in temperatures they are among the most vulnerable places on the planet. The violent sandstorms and erosion are increasingly shaping the dry areas of our planet, bringing incredible discoveries to the light of day. From lost ancient cities to mysterious geological formations, the series deals with incredible puzzles that finally come to light from the desert depths. R.: Kristian Jebsen Ul.: Anthony Cantor (Self - Historian), James Ellis (Self - Historian), Yara Haridy (Self - Evolutionary Biologist), Alison Leonard (Self - Archaeologist), Alex Mifflin (Self - Environmentalist) / Secrets in the Sand - (E06, prirod. film, Kanada, 2023) Rijetko se sjetimo pustinja kada je riječ o klimatskim promjenama, ali s porastom temperatura one se ubrajaju među najranjivija mjesta na planetu. Silovite pješčane oluje i erozija sve više oblikuju suhe predjele našeg planeta i pritom na svjetlo dana donose nevjerojatna otkrića. Od izgubljenih drevnih gradova do misterioznih geoloških formacija, serija se bavi nevjerojatnim zagonetkama koje iz dubina pustinje konačno izlaze na vidjelo. R.: Kristian Jebsen Ul.: Anthony Cantor (Self - Historian), James Ellis (Self - Historian), Yara Haridy (Self - Evolutionary Biologist), Alison Leonard (Self - Archaeologist), Alex Mifflin (Self - Environmentalist)...

programme.title: From the animator / Animatik
programme.desc: Animatics - (cult. Magazine, Croatia) is dedicated to the artistic short but also featurely animated films of Croatian and foreign authors, which will be in full. The animation, also, through contributions and talks with guests in the studio, thematizes certain aspects of work on animated film by showing both new and classic works of Croatia and world animation. The goal of the show is to regularly display animated films in the context of the topic so that viewers have the opportunity to see these titles in their full duration. Authors of animated films, members of film teams, film critics and filmmakers, and the organizers of the festival featuring animated films will be attended in Animatika through contributions and study conversations, film critics and filmmakers, depending on the central topic of the show ... / Animatik - (kult. magazin, Hrvatska) Emisija je posvećena umjetničkim kratkometražnim, ali i dugometražnim animiranim filmovima hrvatskih i inozemnih autora, koji će se prikazivati u cijelosti. Animatik, također, kroz priloge i razgovore s gostima u studiju tematizira pojedine aspekte rada na animiranom filmu prikazujući i nova i klasična djela hrvatske i svjetske animacije. programme.title: Goldbergovi / Goldbergovi

She has full hands of work, starting with Mom Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), who is well-meaning but choke him, through the temperamental dad Murray (Jeff Garlin), to the rebellious older sister Erica (Hayley Orranti) and the hypersensible brother Barry (Troy Gentile). And there is also a reasons grandfather (George Segal), a seducer, who is Adam's mentor when it comes to more beautiful things in life. Driving watches, first jobs, applications for college and acquiring new friends without losing their old ones, it's all part of the Goldberg family. Some leave their childhood behind them in search of the first kiss, others are tormented by the upbringing of teenagers or, faced with aging, remember the youthful passions - the Goldberg family will experience all that. programme.title: Wonderful World of Design - United Kingdom / Čudesni svijet dizajna - Ujedinjeno Kraljevstvo
programme.desc: Grand Designs - (S22, E02, Doc. Series, England, 2024) Business Successful Millennium Zara, professional makeup artist and her partner Giuliano, who works in the IT industry, have decided on a risk venture. Not only because they wanted to leave the Urban Reading to Lincolnshire Forests and a new life in the countryside, but also because for the new home they decided to rearrange the old Slade Factory of 400 square meters into a contemporary villa that would hide all the comfort of a modern home from the inside and will remain on the outside of the 18th century factories. Giuliano is the head of the project, although there is no experience in the building, so he comes across problems from the beginning. From the downtime in the excavation of the foundation to the dizzyingly fast discharge of the budget, which made them both to receive physical work themselves. Will youthful energy and determination help them still complete their ambitious project? R .: Edward Sunderland ... / Grand Designs - (S22, E02, dok. serija, Engleska, 2024) Poslovno uspješni milenijci Zara, profesionalna šminkerica i njezin partner Giuliano, koji radi u IT industriji, odlučili su se na rizični pothvat. Ne samo zato što su htjeli otići iz urbanog Readinga u šume Lincolnshirea i novi život na selu, nego i zato što su za novi dom odlučili preurediti staru tvornicu slada od 400 četvornih metara u suvremenu vilu koja će sve udobnosti modernog doma skrivati iznutra, a izvana će ostati izgledom tvornica iz 18. stoljeća. Giuliano je voditelj tog projekta iako u građevini nema nikakva iskustva pa na probleme nailazi od samog početka. Od zastoja u iskapanju temelja do vrtoglavo brzog pražnjenja budžeta zbog kojega su se i sami, oboje, morali primiti fizičkog posla. Hoće li im mladenačka energija i odlučnost pomoći da ipak završe svoj ambiciozni projekt? R.: Edward Sunderland...

programme.title: Rick Stein i njegov Cornwall / Rick Stein i njegov Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick Steins Cornwall - (S01, E03, Educational Program, England, 2021) Rick Stein meets young chef Tom Adams, who runs the Combeshead farm and the most famous restaurant in Cornwall operating on the "Field to Table to Table" principle. He grows all the foods and prepares various dishes from them, from sour dough to pork pie. In addition, there are a little flock of hairy pigs of the mangulica, an old breed that gives an excellent ham. Rick tries to make a new recipe, a pork chop in a trnin sauce, and then goes to Rock, where his son Jack at the mouth of the Camel River is preparing dishes of the seafood outdoors. R .: Matt Bennett Ul.: Tom Adams (Self) ... / Rick Steins Cornwall - (S01, E03, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2021) Rick Stein upoznaje mladog kuhara Toma Adamsa, koji vodi farmu Combeshead i najpoznatiji restoran u Cornwallu koji posluje po principu "od polja do stola". Sam uzgaja sve namirnice i od njih priprema razna jela, od kruha s kiselim tijestom do pita od svinjetine. Uz to ima i malo stado dlakavih svinja mangulica, stare pasmine koja daje izvrsnu šunku. Rick isprobava novi recept, svinjske kotlete u umaku od trnina, a zatim odlazi u mjestašce Rock, gdje njegov sin Jack na ušću rijeke Camel sprema jela od plodova mora na otvorenom. programme.title: Jamie's soul food / Jamiejeva hrana za dušu
programme.desc: Jamies Comfort food - (E03, known. Pop. Series, England, 2013) The third episode begins with the preparation of a sandwich with fine meat and caramelized onions. Jamie will then prepare the lasagna, but his version will still be a little different. They will prepare them with crunchy baked duck and exciting bread crumbs. It will be a real pleasure for the palate. Jamie will then, along with your mother, prepare your favorite British classic, a sticky caramel dessert you haven't tried yet. Finally, it will also prepare an excellent Italian classic - Ossobuco alla Milanese and the prepared risotto with saffron. R .: Mike Matthews ... / Jamies Comfort Food - (E03, znan. pop. serija, Engleska, 2013) Treća epizoda počinje pripremom sendviča s finim mesom i karameliziranim lukom. Jamie će zatim pripremiti lazanje, ali njegova verzija će ipak biti malo drukčija. Pripremit će ih s hrskavom pečenom patkom i uzbudljivim krušnim mrvicama. Bit će to pravi užitak za nepce. Jamie će zatim, zajedno s majkom, pripremiti omiljeni britanski klasik, ljepljivu slasticu od karamela kakvu niste još probali. Na kraju, pripremit će i izvrstan talijanski klasik - ossobuco alla milanese i prefini rižoto sa šafranom. R.: Mike Matthews...

programme.title: A new beginning with Ben Fogle / Novi početak s Benom Fogleom
programme.desc: Ben Fogle: Make A New Life in the Country - (S01, E02, Educational Program, England, 2019) Ben Fogle travels to the town of Ulverston in Cumbia, located in a beautiful rural landscape not far from the Lake District. They will visit Kat and Guilla who opened the coffee shop and a restaurant there. Kat left a well -paid lawyer's job in London City and replaced the apartment on the Temze coast with a 300 -year -old warehouse in Ulverston, which she decided to rearrange into a catering facility. As a passionate cyclist, she chose the area because of the magnificently beautiful landscape. She went to the whole project just months after falling in love with Italian Guilla, a chef who dreamed of creating her own pizza recipes. Ben Fogle will try their daily life. She will talk to Kat about her determination to accomplish her plan, the reasons that motivated her to leave her well paid job in the city and start to live and work with a new partner for 24 hours a day. R .: Josh Goode Ul.: Ben Fogle (Self - Present) ... / Ben Fogle: Make a New Life in the Country - (S01, E02, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2019) Ben Fogle putuje u gradić Ulverston u Cumbriji, smješten u prelijepom ruralnom krajoliku nedaleko od Lake Districta. Posjetit će Kat i Guilla koji su ondje otvorili kavanu i restoran. Kat je ostavila dobro plaćen odvjetnički posao u londonskom Cityju te stan na obali Temze zamijenila 300 godina starim skladištem u Ulverstonu koji je odlučila preurediti u ugostiteljski objekt. Kao strastvena biciklistica, izabrala je taj kraj zbog veličanstveno lijepih krajolika. U cijeli projekt upustila se samo nekoliko mjeseci nakon što se zaljubila u Talijana Guilla, kuhara koji je sanjao o tome da kreira vlastite recepte za pizzu. Ben Fogle iskušat će njihov svakodnevni život. Razgovarat će s Kat o njezinoj odlučnosti da ostvari svoj plan, o razlozima koji su je motivirali da ostavi dobro plaćen posao u gradu te počne 24 sata dnevno živjeti i raditi s novim partnerom. R.: Josh Goode Ul.: Ben Fogle (Self - Presenter)...

The air shots also bring stunning staff of other Karlovac rivers and rastok waterfalls. On the banks of the Korana River, we will get to know Sanda Križan, a member of the GSS, and her Kate, a demanding dog of the Croatian Mountain Rescue Service. In some ancient times, we will be reminded of the replica of the old cereal ship that the drone encounters in the village of Kamensko. The boatmanship in the Kupa and Sava Rijeka area was developed even before large cities were built, and Jasmina Cvetković will be introduced to her history. At the foot of Klek, in a small village near Ogulin, we will also meet a professor of English who decided to deal with livestock and move to the countryside, and the drone shots will also show us a special welcome of the Summer in Karlovac - Ivanjski Brjus. The city of Karlovac is also interesting in the phenomenon of fog. According to some data, the city spends as much as 78 days a year under fog. In the early fall, our shots reveal to us the spectacular sunrise over Karlovac in a pastel colored sky under fog. Not far from the old town of Dubovac, we will also meet the local chestnuts, who spends the autumn days collecting chestnuts and selling it to the center of Karlovac. We will end the journey with this water pearl of Croatia in Novigrad to Dobra, where we will see the river good covered with snow. Omeđen s četiri rijeke, kraj je ovo bogatih prirodnih ljepota i kulturne baštine. Grad Karlovac zanimljiv je i po fenomenu magle. Prema nekim podacima, grad provede čak 78 dana godišnje pod maglom. In this sense, the program "Jazz Continuo" is set aside in 2012, launched by Mario Mavrin, Primož Grašič and Vid Jamnik. This year's "Jazz Continuo" was held on January 15th in the small hall of V. Lisinski, was of particular importance because it was marked 90 years from Bosk's birth. In addition to Mavrina on bass guitars and peas guitars, David Gazarov and Emil Spanyi on the piano and Cristophe Bras on drums performed on this occasion. The program was made up of Bosk's own compositions and his favorite standards, and the performances of his friends and close associates confirmed that Bosk's importance would last as long as jazz lasts ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Boško Petrović osnovni je orijentir i središnja figura našeg modernog jazza. Kao muzičara i kompozitora, Boškova je važnost evidentna: tu su nebrojene snimke, s perjanicama jazza domaćim i međunarodnim, danas podjednako rado slušane, a tu je i bogat autorski opus koji nastavljaju interpretirati nove generacije muzičara. Te nas nove generacije pak podsjećaju na Boška pedagoga, koji predstavlja kamen temeljac naše današnje jazz scene: brojne danas aktivne muzičarke i muzičari oblikovani su pod njegovim utjecajem, što je možda i najljepši oblik trajanja - kroz vlastite učenike i glazbene potomke. Naravno, tu su i Boškovi suputnici, koji nastavljaju obilježavati njegov neusporedivi doprinos našem jazzu. U tom se smislu izdvaja program "Jazz continuo" koji su 2012. godine pokrenuli Mario Mavrin, Primož Grašič i Vid Jamnik. Ovogodišnji je "Jazz continuo", održan 15. siječnja u Maloj Dvorani V. Lisinskog, bio od posebnog značaja jer se njime obilježilo 90. godina od Boškovog rođenja. Uz Mavrina na bas gitari i Grašiča gitari, tim su povodom nastupili David Gazarov i Emil Spanyi na klaviru te Cristophe Bras na bubnjevima. Program je bio sastavljen od Boškovih vlastitih kompozicija i omiljenih mu standarda, a izvedbe njegovih prijatelja i bliskih suradnika potvrdile su da će Boškova važnost trajati dok god traje jazz u nas...

programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2022) Stanislaw Lem, Polish writer, philosopher and satirist, is the most translated Polish writer. In 2021, the hundredth anniversary of his birth was celebrated and was proclaimed a "year of Stanislaw Lem" in Poland. In Croatian, we could read the novel "Solaris" from 1961, one of the most important novels of the 20th century, according to which Andrej Tarkovski made in 1972. And in the anniversary year, translator Adrian Cvitanovic translated four more books of book. On the thin border of poetry and reality is "Babanija", the world caught among the cover of Miroslav Kirin's book. Inspired by the real geographical categories and real people, Kirin is the world where he grew up re -created. Because Banija, he writes, is now a mythical micro -earth. Godine 2021. slavila se stota obljetnica njegova rođenja i u Poljskoj je proglašena "Godinom Stanislawa Lema". Na hrvatskom smo mogli čitati roman "Solaris" iz 1961. godine, jedan od najvažnijih romana 20. stoljeća, prema kojemu je Andrej Tarkovski snimio 1972. godine istoimeni film. A u obljetničkoj godini prevoditelj Adrian Cvitanović preveo je još četiri Lemove knjige. Na tankoj granici poezije i zbilje nalazi se "Babanija", svijet uhvaćen među koricama knjige Miroslava Kirina. Nadahnut stvarnim geografskim kategorijama i stvarnim ljudima, Kirin je svijet u kojem je odrastao ponovno stvorio. Jer Banija je, piše, sad već mitska mikrozemlja. Zemlja koju se svako malo nužno mora reimaginirati. Banski kraj, Banska krajina, Banska granica, Banal Grenze, Banija, Banovina, itd. Naš je gost autor 10 pjesničkih zbirki i autofikcionalnog romana "Album" za koji je dobio nagradu Jutarnjeg lista, esejist i prevoditelj Miroslav Kirin...

programme.desc: Oasis - (E03, Nature. Film, France, 2022) Djebel Akhdar, in the Arabian "Green Mountain", is a symbol of the fertility of the Oman oasis in which the true little miracle of greenery and vegetation is hidden. On these rocky slopes, farmers have been cultivating hanging gardens for centuries. In this truly dry region, they found imaginative ways to pump water hiding in the wombs of the mountains. This precious resource enabled the villagers to create magnificent oases in which roses, orchards and cereals succeed. For centuries, unchanged lifestyle of the residents here is threatened by modernization, but scientists have been trying to discover the secrets of their oasis's longevity. Aware of the natural treasures they inherited from ancestors, the villagers in these parts still continue to cultivate the land. R .: Guy Beauche ... / Oasis - (E03, prirod. film, Francuska, 2022) Djebel Akhdar, na arapskom "zelena planina", simbol je plodnosti omanskih oaza u kojem se skriva pravo malo čudo zelenila i vegetacije. Na ovim stjenovitim obroncima poljoprivrednici već stoljećima obrađuju viseće vrtove. U ovoj uistinu sušnoj regiji, pronašli su domišljate načine za crpljenje vode koja se krije u utrobama planina. Taj dragocjeni resurs omogućio je seljanima da stvore veličanstvene oaze u kojima uspijevaju ružičnjaci, voćnjaci i žitarice. Stoljećima nepromijenjen način života ovdašnjih stanovnika danas je ugrožen modernizacijom, no znanstvenici pokušavaju otkriti tajne dugovječnosti njihovih oaza. programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2022) Stanislaw Lem, Polish writer, philosopher and satirist, is the most translated Polish writer. In 2021, the hundredth anniversary of his birth was celebrated and was proclaimed a "year of Stanislaw Lem" in Poland. In Croatian, we could read the novel "Solaris" from 1961, one of the most important novels of the 20th century, according to which Andrej Tarkovski made in 1972. And in the anniversary year, translator Adrian Cvitanovic translated four more books of book. On the thin border of poetry and reality is "Babanija", the world caught among the cover of Miroslav Kirin's book. Inspired by the real geographical categories and real people, Kirin is the world where he grew up re -created. Because Banija, he writes, is now a mythical micro -earth. A country that must be reimagated every now and then. Banski Kraj, Bansko Krajina, Bansko Border, Banal Grenze, Banija, Banovina, etc. Our guest is the author of 10 poetic collections and an automatic novel "The Album" for which he received the Jutarnji List Award, essayist and translator Miroslav Kirin ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2022) Stanislaw Lem, poljski književnik, filozof i satiričar, najprevođeniji je poljski pisac. Godine 2021. slavila se stota obljetnica njegova rođenja i u Poljskoj je proglašena "Godinom Stanislawa Lema". Na hrvatskom smo mogli čitati roman "Solaris" iz 1961. godine, jedan od najvažnijih romana 20. stoljeća, prema kojemu je Andrej Tarkovski snimio 1972. godine istoimeni film. A u obljetničkoj godini prevoditelj Adrian Cvitanović preveo je još četiri Lemove knjige. Na tankoj granici poezije i zbilje nalazi se "Babanija", svijet uhvaćen među koricama knjige Miroslava Kirina. Nadahnut stvarnim geografskim kategorijama i stvarnim ljudima, Kirin je svijet u kojem je odrastao ponovno stvorio. Jer Banija je, piše, sad već mitska mikrozemlja. Zemlja koju se svako malo nužno mora reimaginirati. Banski kraj, Banska krajina, Banska granica, Banal Grenze, Banija, Banovina, itd. Naš je gost autor 10 pjesničkih zbirki i autofikcionalnog romana "Album" za koji je dobio nagradu Jutarnjeg lista, esejist i prevoditelj Miroslav Kirin...

No već prvoga dana netko ukrade bicikl. Sada Antoniju nema druge nego da, zajedno sa sinom, krene u potragu za lopovom i pokuša pronaći bicikl. Kako vrijeme odmiče, a vjerojatnost da će pronaći ukradeno sve manja, Antonio postaje sve očajniji. Ipak, u jednom mu se trenutku učini da je pronašao bicikl... R.: Vittorio De Sica Ul.: Lamberto Maggiorani (Antonio), Enzo Staiola (Bruno), Lianella Carell (Maria), Elena Altieri (The Charitable Lady), Gino Saltamerenda (Baiocco)...

programme.desc: Out of format - (Artistic program, Croatia, 2024) There are no great things without small things, said Sasa Simpraga. This publicist, activist, author of several books on architecture and art, and founder and head of the platform 1postzagragrad for the last two decades with his words and actions in the public space, warns that changes are often not unattainable and that small steps are sufficient to happen. The conversations he has led with urbanists, architects, conservators, art historians and all those who reflect on public space and planning of the city have been reprimanded in the book under the title Synthesis in the edition of Vizkulture. And we did not invite Sasha Šimpraga to the studio but sought him, where else, than in the streets of the city that has been in the center of his interest and action for years. Razgovori koje je posljednjih sedam godina vodio s urbanistima, arhitektima, konzervatorima, povjesničarima umjetnosti i svima onima koji promišljaju javni prostor i planiranje grada, ukoričeni su u knjizi pod naslovom Grad je sinteza u izdanju Vizkulture. A mi Sašu Šimpragu nismo pozvali u studio već smo ga potražili, gdje drugdje, nego na ulicama grada koji je već godinama u središtu njegova interesa i djelovanja. R.: Vesna Luković Žarn...

Finally, the literary critic Dario Grgić talks about the Bosnian writer and philosopher Predrag Fini. I za kraj, književni kritičar Dario Grgić govori o bosanskohercegovačkom književniku i filozofu Predragu Finciju.
